notes: No objective. Starting cards as posted under 'Starting (6)': Coruscant: Jedi Council Chamber, Podrace Prep, Boonta Eve Podrace, Tatooine: Podrace Arena, Anakin's Podracer, Seeking An Audience; these count toward the 60 (Seeking An Audience taken as the free Effect Podrace Prep deploys).
The post calls itself a non-Reflections III deck; no Reflections III cards are listed.

Posted 'Coruscant Jedi Council' dested Coruscant: Jedi Council Chamber; 'Tatooine Lars Farm' dested Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm; 'Naked Threepio' dested Threepio With His Parts Showing; 'Owen and Beru Lars' dested Owen Lars & Beru Lars.
Posted 'Artoo' dested Artoo (Jabba's Palace), the only card titled Artoo before Theed Palace.
Posted 'Rebel Snowspeeder x14 {the good ones}' dested Rebel Snowspeeder (ESB Introductory Two-Player Game), the card with that exact title, rather than the Hoth Snowspeeder.
Posted 'Savrip' dested Mantellian Savrip (deploys free with C-3PO on table; the deck runs Threepio With His Parts Showing).
Posted 'Tatooine Mos Espa' and 'Tatooine Hutt Trade Route' dested the Light sites Tatooine: Mos Espa and Tatooine: Hutt Trade Route (Desert).
The post's edit says to swap the 2 Incom Corporation for 2 Qui-Gon Jinn (Tatooine); the list is kept as published.
The title and description joke about WWF wrestlers' talking watches; it is a real Light Side list.
